hero.title: Turn Your Home into the {highlight} in Town.
hero.subtitle: The digital menu for home baristas. Create your drink list, share your QR code with friends and family, and receive orders straight to your phone.
hero.noCreditCard: No credit card required. No ads. Just love.

valueProp.heading: Why shout from the kitchen?
valueProp.problemText: Shouting from the kitchen, "Who wants tea?" and forgetting who wanted sugar and who wanted almond milk by the time the kettle boils.
valueProp.solutionText: My Tiny Café brings the delight of a boutique coffee shop experience to your living room. Make the moment special.

howItWorks.title: How It Works (3 Simple Steps)
howItWorks.step1Text: Give your café a name. Add your specialties—Latte, Tisane, or Tartine. Customize options for milk and sugar.
howItWorks.step2Text: Print your QR code for the fridge or text the link. Guests browse and customize their beverage exactly how they like it.
howItWorks.step3Text: Ding! You get a notification instantly. No money changes hands—just a perfect cup served with a smile.

features.title: Features
features.feature1Text: From "Tisane d'allaitement" to "Iced Matcha", you define what you serve.
features.feature2Text: Never miss an order. You'll know the second your "customer" submits their request.
features.feature3Text: Guests just scan (or click) and order. No installation needed.
features.feature4Text: No payment gateways. The only currency here is gratitude.

stories.title: Real Stories
stories.quote1: Can I use your app to order a tea, dad?
stories.quote2: It's so much easier to order a coffee for when I get back home. And the barista is super cute too!

audience.title: Who is My Tiny Café For?
audience.card1Text: Send a silent order for a caffeine boost without interrupting the Zoom meeting.
audience.card2Text: Impress your guests by letting them order their post-meal digestif via a digital menu.
audience.card3Text: Kids love playing "restaurant." Set up the menu for them and let them take your order.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: Yes! My Tiny Café is currently completely free to use.
faq.q2: Can I charge money for the drinks?
faq.a2: No. This app is designed for friends and family. There is no payment processing involved—just the joy of serving a drink to someone you care about.
faq.q3: What can I put on the menu?
faq.a3: Anything! Coffee, tea, snacks, tartines, water... if you can make it in your kitchen, you can put it on your menu.

openSource.title: Proudly Open Source
openSource.text: I believe in transparency and community. My Tiny Café is open source, so you can see exactly how it's built, contribute features, or host it yourself.

footer.title: Ready to open shop?
footer.subtitle: Join the community of home baristas today.
footer.madeWith: Made with ❤️ in France for Zola and Magali.
footer.aboutMakerText: I am Alix, I built this to make my wife and daughter happy. I hope it brings a little joy to your home too. I am a freelance frontend developer (preferably in Vue.js / Nuxt.js) with a background in Human-Computer Interaction research. {link}.
